Configure a 2D transient incompressible laminar flow-past-a-cylinder simulation in OpenFOAM using pimpleFoam.
The mesh is 2D with one cell thickness in the z-direction.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, define the patch frontAndBack with type empty.
In 0/U, define the boundary condition for frontAndBack as type empty.
In 0/p, define the boundary condition for frontAndBack as type empty.
In 0/nu (or via transportProperties), define frontAndBack as type empty if a nu field file exists, or rely on the transport model applying it uniformly.
Set the inlet patch boundary condition for U to type fixedValue with value uniform (1 0 0).
Set the inlet patch boundary condition for p to type zeroGradient.
Set the outlet patch boundary condition for U to type inletOutlet with inletValue uniform (0 0 0).
Set the outlet patch boundary condition for p to type fixedValue with value uniform 0.
Set the cylinderWall patch boundary condition for U to type noSlip.
Set the cylinderWall patch boundary condition for p to type zeroGradient.
Set the transport model in constant/transportModel to Newtonian.
Set the kinematic viscosity nu in constant/transportProperties to uniform 0.001.
The target Reynolds number is approximately 100, achieved with U_inlet = 1 m/s, D = 0.1 m, and nu = 0.001 m2/s.
Do NOT activate any turbulence model; use only the laminar transport properties in pimpleFoam.
In system/fvSchemes, set the convection scheme for div(phi,U) to Gauss upwind for numerical stability at Re = 100.
Set the gradient scheme for grad(U) and laplacian(nu, U) to the default Gauss linear and Gauss linearCorrected respectively.
In system/fvSolution, use the default pimple algorithm with at least 2 correctors and at least 3 non-orthogonal correctors.
Set the time step in system/controlDict to 0.01 s, yielding a CFL number below 1 for the given grid and velocity.
Set the end time to 50 s to capture several vortex-shedding cycles (the expected shedding period at Re 100 is approximately 0.6 s).
Set the write interval to 1 s for post-processing.
Ensure all three files (constant/polyMesh/boundary, 0/U, 0/p) consistently use the empty type for frontAndBack, with no remaining symmetryPlane or wall type references to that patch.
